## 1. What Drove the Sector Today

**Primary driver: Defensive rotation on a risk-off tape.** SPY fell −0.39% while XLU held flat. The Schwab headline from today — "Hot Jobs Report Hurts Stocks, Lifts Rate Hike Odds" — indicates a strong jobs print that pushed rate-hike odds to 63% for September. This is a **hawkish repricing day**, and utilities held up as the defensive destination.
